preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line (the number of test cases).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line) >= 2 and all(c in 'EN' for c in line) for line in stdin.strip().split()[1:]) if len(stdin.strip().split()) > 1 else True
preconditions.description: Each test case line is a non-empty string of length at least 2 consisting only of characters 'E' and 'N'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'YES') == (not (s == 'N' * len(s))) for line, s in zip(stdout.strip().split(), stdin.strip().split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is 'YES' if and only if s is not composed entirely of 'N' characters; otherwise it is 'NO'.
